design: ONE long-lived process (the gateway). No supervisor, no watchdog, no front-fleet, no per-front ports. Backends are dispatch descriptors: kind=module (imported in-process), kind=binary (spawned per invocation, reaped on return), kind=mcp-stdio (managed worker pool), kind=mcp-http / kind=mcp-sse (one-shot MCP clients to operator-owned servers), kind=msgrpc (metasploit msgpack-rpc client) or kind=unavailable (no real transport on this box; carries install_note). The kind=rpc stub class was removed 2026-09-30: available ALWAYS means a real protocol round-trip succeeded. Availability is computed lazily from what is actually importable/on PATH - never a static flag that can drift.
